subject: Clarifying product-output & training carveouts — MSA + Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Olivia Price <olivia@novum.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novum Legal <legal@novum.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA & Order Form redlines re: product output + training carveouts

Hi Irene / Ben —

Thanks for the call last week. Attached are Novum's redlines to the MSA and the Order Form (Annex A). The primary items we flagged relate to:

- Output ownership: we need explicit language that downstream productization of model outputs produced from customer content is permitted under a limited license back to the customer.
- Training: we are not comfortable with a broad customer feedback license that allows model retraining without an explicit opt-in consent.
- Feedback telemetry: we want narrower telemetry retention periods and a prohibition on using customer PII for any model updates.

I've annotated the PDF with line-level comments (Novum_Redlines_MSA_v1.pdf). For the Order Form, we've proposed an Annex that enumerates the allowed product uses and carveouts (OrderForm_AnnexA_redlines.docx).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (1) accept a narrow, non-exclusive license back to Novum for outputs used internally and productized by Novum; (2) provide an opt-in checkbox to allow Novum to elect whether feedback can be used for model training; and (3) add a telemetry retention cap (we suggested 12 months)?

If it's easier, happy to hop on a quick 30-min sync with your contracts lead and product counsel early next week.

Thanks,

Olivia Price
Head of Legal Operations
Novum.ai

Attachments: Novum_Redlines_MSA_v1.pdf (annotated PDF), OrderForm_AnnexA_redlines.docx (proposed annex)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Price <olivia@novum.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines re: product output + training carveouts

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and very clear annotations. Quick summary from our side after an initial pass:

- Output ownership: we can support a limited, non-exclusive license back to Novum that allows productization of outputs derived from Novum-provided prompts/content, with a clarified scope that excludes any model weights or training artifacts. We'd propose wording that grants Novum "a perpetual, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use and commercialize outputs generated from their content" but excludes rights to retrain or redistribute our models.

- Training/feedback: Redwood's standard approach is to collect anonymized feedback for aggregate quality improvements. We are open to an opt-in flag on a per-customer basis; however, that will require a short implementation lead time (we estimate ~3–4 weeks for a UI flag and audit hooks).

- Telemetry retention: 12 months is reasonable for most telemetry; where customers require shorter retention we'll support contract-level exceptions.

Action items / asks from Novum before we redline back:
1) Confirm the exact wording you want for the output license (a short sample clause is ideal).
2) Confirm whether the opt-in applies to all telemetry or only to data used for retraining.
3) Identify any data residency / PII constraints we should reflect in the Order Form annex.

Ben (cc) — could your team estimate the engineering/ops work to add an opt-in for feedback collection and the auditing hooks (traceability/audit logs) so we can give Novum a timeline? Grace — would appreciate your help drafting the sample clause for the non-exclusive output license.

If novum is available Monday we can take the 30-min sync — propose Mon 10am PT.

Best,

Irene Choi
Head of Product Counsel
Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Jan 7, 2028 at 9:12 AM Olivia Price <olivia@novum.ai> wrote:
> > (Novum attachments and notes)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Price <olivia@novum.ai>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2028 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines re: product output + training carveouts

Irene / Olivia —

Quick ops note on implementation: adding an opt-in toggle for customers to allow feedback to be used for retraining is doable but we should separate two scopes:

1) Feedback used for aggregate quality signals (metrics, bug triage) — low effort, largely analytics changes.
2) Data used to produce training examples for model updates — higher effort: requires sanitization pipelines, consent records, and tagging/audit trails.

Estimate: 2–3 weeks for the opt-in UI + audit logs for scope (1), 6–8 weeks for full safe-path to use data for retraining with required tooling (scope 2). We can phase delivery and offer Novum the option to start with scope (1) while legal finalizes scope (2).

I'll have a short implementation plan before the Monday sync.

Ben
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Price <olivia@novum.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Novum Legal <legal@novum.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 14:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines re: product output + training carveouts

Thanks — this is helpful. Novum Legal reviewed and prefers the following approach before we proceed to signature:

- Output license clause: we will share a brief sample clause that grants Novum a perpetual, non-exclusive license to outputs with an explicit prohibition on redistributing or reusing Redwood model weights. We'll send that clause by end of day Monday.
- Opt-in: Novum prefers the opt-in to cover any use of customer-provided content for model training (scope 2). We understand the longer implementation timeline; the parties can agree in the Order Form to a timeline to enable scope 2 and a phased acceptance for scope 1 in the interim.
- Telemetry: confirm 12-month cap unless shorter retention is required by Novum-specific data handling policies.

We can do Mon 10am PT for the sync. Please include your contracts lead and an engineering representative.

Appreciate the pragmatic phasing — looking forward to getting an updated redline.

Olivia Price
Head of Legal Operations
Novum.ai

Attachments in this message: none (see earlier)
